evidence.appropriate: the P becomes a head with one eye turned to the page: the name and the friend in one shape
evidence.distinctive: an eye in a counter is a known device, but no reading app uses a leaning P; generic in silhouette
evidence.simple: one letter, one dot; drawable in two strokes
evidence.legible: the P reads at every size; the eye drops out in the favicon tier by design
evidence.adaptable: one-colour and reverse hold; the icon is a letter, strong on a home screen
evidence.timeless: no trend shape; a single letter in a rounded sans
evidence.universal: mirrored reads as q, rotated reads as a tag; nothing unwanted
evidence.clear: description search (P with eye in counter) found templates but no named mark; P monograms are crowded
evidence.congruent: round type and a lean match; a lettermark is less of a character than the strategy asks
evidence.system: lockups and tiers build; the favicon loses the eye
